notablePrerequisites:
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Krosan Restorer.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, targeting itself and up to two other mana-producing lands.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving target creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Krosan Restorer ability, untapping it and the mana-producing lands.
Activate up to two mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat.
